description: Test suite for argv helper functions in a CLI application, containing unit tests that validate command-line argument parsing, flag detection, command extraction, and related behaviors.

methods.name: buildParseArgv
methods.description: Function to parse raw command line arguments into a normalized argv array, handling special cases like node version binaries and fallback arguments.

methods.name: getFlagValue
methods.description: Extracts the value associated with a specific flag from argv.

methods.name: getCommandPath
methods.description: Retrieves command path tokens up to a specified index, stopping at terminator tokens.

methods.name: getCommandPathWithRootOptions
methods.description: Extracts command path tokens while skipping known root option flags and their values.

methods.name: getCommandPositionalsWithRootOptions
methods.description: Gets positional arguments for a routed command, ignoring interleaved root options.

methods.name: getPrimaryCommand
methods.description: Returns the first command token, skipping root flags.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if a specific flag is present before the terminator token.

methods.name: getVerboseFlag
methods.description: Checks for verbose debug flags like --verbose or --debug.

methods.name: getPositiveIntFlagValue
methods.description: Parses and returns a positive integer value following a given flag.

methods.name: shouldMigrateState
methods.description: Determines if migration state should be performed based on command patterns.

methods.name: shouldMigrateStateFromPath
methods.description: Decides migration based on command path segments.

methods.name: hasHelpOrVersion
methods.description: Detects if help or version flags are present.

methods.name: isRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Checks if help is invoked at root level, without subcommand context.

methods.name: isRootVersionInvocation
methods.description: Checks if version is invoked at root level, without subcommand context.
